issues.description: User is being redirected to the auth page instead of seeing the step-8a render result screen. The URL is /auth?next=%2Fdesign%2Fstep-8a, meaning the middleware or auth guard is blocking access to /design/step-8a and forcing login.
issues.element: Entire page — should show render result with before/after slider, but shows auth wall instead
issues.root_cause: The /design/step-8a route requires authentication. The middleware at apps/web/middleware.ts (or similar) is redirecting unauthenticated users to /auth. Additionally, console logs show repeated 500 Internal Server Errors which suggest the backend/session check is failing, possibly due to a broken auth API route at apps/web/app/api/auth or a missing session cookie.

issues.description: Repeated 500 Internal Server Error responses in console logs. This indicates a server-side crash in an API route, likely the auth session endpoint or the render status endpoint for step-8a.
issues.root_cause: An API route (likely apps/web/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts or a session handler) is throwing an uncaught exception. This prevents successful authentication and blocks access to the render result screen.

issues.description: Page event logs show 'page:mount' firing for 'auth' page twice on each load, suggesting a double-render or duplicate instrumentation in the auth page component.
issues.element: Auth page mount event fired twice per load
issues.root_cause: apps/web/app/auth/page.tsx likely has a duplicate useEffect or logger call that fires the page:mount event, or React StrictMode is causing double invocation.
